privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p_data: We process: name, phone and/or email, visit and reward history, card language and – if you enter it – the day and month of your birthday.
privacy.p_purpose: Purpose: running the loyalty program (stamps, rewards, appointment reminders).
privacy.p_basis: Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can withdraw it at any time.
privacy.p_retention: We keep the data while you are in the program; after deletion only anonymous statistics remain.
privacy.p_rights: You have the right to access, correct, delete and port your data. Just ask the salon in person or by phone.
privacy.p_processor: The service is technically operated by {{app}} as the salon's processor.
privacy.template_note: Template – have it reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
privacy.p_marketing: If you agreed to offers, the salon may send messages to your card: offers, a reminder when you have not visited for a while, and birthday wishes. You can unsubscribe with one tap on your card page.

landing.title: Turn every client into a regular.
landing.lead: A digital loyalty card in Apple and Google Wallet. No app, no paper – and the card reminds your customers when it is time to come back.
landing.for_whom: For nail studios, hair salons, barbershops, beauty, cafés and any place people like to come back to.
landing.how_1: Set the reward and colors, print the poster. It takes about 10 minutes.
landing.how_2: The client scans the QR code and has the card in Apple or Google Wallet in seconds. No app, no password.
landing.how_3: Reception scans the card and adds a stamp. The card on her phone updates itself and sends a notification.
landing.f_wallet_t: On the phone, not in a drawer
landing.f_wallet: Paper cards get lost. A Wallet card is always at hand, next to boarding passes.
landing.f_winback: When a client hasn't come back for a while, she gets a gentle nudge – based on how often she usually visits.
landing.f_appt: The next appointment is on the card, with a reminder the day before. Fewer missed visits.
landing.f_bday: Automatic birthday wishes with a gift you choose.
landing.f_msg: A slot opened up tomorrow? One message reaches everyone who opted in.
landing.f_counter: Scan, +1 stamp, next. A new client is signed up in 20 seconds.
landing.f_gdpr: Dated consents, one-click export and deletion, data stored in the EU.
landing.f_lang: Every client sees the card in her own language.
landing.demo_text: Add a demo card to your phone and see exactly what your clients will see.
landing.pilot_text: During the pilot, Stálka is free for 2 months. I will help you set it up in person – in Bratislava, right at your place.
landing.footer: Loyalty cards in Apple and Google Wallet
landing.trial: First 30 days free, no credit card.
landing.inc_2: Card in Apple and Google Wallet
landing.inc_5: QR poster and help with setup
landing.cancel: No commitment – if you don't like it, you simply don't continue.
landing.eyebrow: For salons, studios and cafés in Slovakia
landing.notif_text: It's been a while 🙂 Stálka Demo would love to see you again. Book your next visit.
landing.vs_paper_1: Gets lost in a bag or left at home
landing.vs_paper_2: Never reminds the client of anything
landing.vs_paper_3: You don't know who stopped coming
landing.vs_stalka_1: Lives on the phone, next to boarding passes
landing.vs_stalka_2: Reminds her of appointments and to come back
landing.vs_stalka_3: You see who comes back and who doesn't
landing.faq_1_q: Does the client need to install anything?
landing.faq_1_a: No. She scans the QR code with her camera and adds the card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, which are already on her phone. No app, no password.
landing.faq_2_q: What if a client doesn't want the card on her phone?
landing.faq_2_a: The card also works as a web page with a QR code. Reception can find her by name or phone number too.
landing.faq_3_a: No. You add stamps with an ordinary phone or tablet with a camera.
landing.faq_4_a: If you want to continue, it's €14.90 a month or €149 a year. If not, you simply stop – no contracts or commitments.
landing.faq_5_a: Yes. Consent is stored with a date and the version of the text, consent to offers is separate and optional. You can export or delete a client's data in one click. Data is stored in the EU.
landing.final_text: Setup takes about 10 minutes. No credit card needed.
landing.lead_short: A loyalty card in Apple and Google Wallet that reminds your customers when it is time to come back.
